label: ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_2: act reading, r is actual in x through the act a
definition: `ActualizationFrame.ActualizedBy x r a`, explicitly primitive: in x, the respect r is actual through the act a, as q.4 a.1 ad 3 says esse is 'actualitas omnium rerum, et etiam ipsarum formarum' and q.3 a.4 co. that 'esse est actualitas omnis formae vel naturae'. Distinguishing conditions: it is not co-possession (ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_1); no law relates the two, and no structural property (transitivity, irreflexivity) is assumed. Open semantic obligation: what makes an act the act through which a form is actual, beyond the dependence of every actuality on being. Example: a form actual in matter (q.7 a.1 parallel); for esse itself no example independent of the thesis is on file.
note: Stipulative analyst definition, attribution deferred; navigated from ST I q.4 a.1 ad 3, q.3 a.4 co. and De ente capp.3-4 (Baur/Koch), read in the materialized witnesses (docs/notes/rdep-to-ract.md).
